caseName: McCaw v. Superior Court of California ex rel. Los Angeles County
caseNameFull: McCaw v. Superior Court of California, in and for Los Angeles County
attorneys: Bernard Reich for petitioners., Howard I. Friedman for Union Bank.

opinions.text: The motion to correct title and caption to show Union Bank as a party respondent is granted. Petition for writ of certio-rari to the Supreme Court of California denied.
